# Credential reference

This table lists every credential class in the registry. Live means the class is not retired.
It does not mean every deployment enables it or that an endpoint accepts it.
The acceptor column states where it is used. A context header is not proof of identity.

Regenerate this page from the repository root with `go run ./cmd/credrefgen`.
Update the public summaries in `docs-data/auth/credential-reference.json` when behavior changes.
See the [auth architecture](../../operate/architecture/auth-control-plane.md) for the request path.

| Class id | What it is | Issuer | Accepted by | Format and markers | Storage | Rotation and expiry | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `acr_browser_refresh_token` | Ask Dev browser refresh credential | Ask Dev browser token service | Ask Dev browser refresh route | Opaque acrrt_ prefix and 32 random bytes; grant_type=refresh_token | SHA-256 digest in acr.browser_refresh_tokens; family in acr.browser_token_families | Single use; 30-second grace while the successor is unused; issues a 10-minute client credential. | live |
| `acr_client_credential` | Ask Dev client credential | Ask Dev credential service | Ask Dev credential validators | Opaque secret; credential_prefix=fcacr_; authorization_scheme=Bearer | Digest in the Ask Dev credential store | Self-service rotation with bounded overlap; revoked sources cannot rotate. | live |
| `acr_device_flow_code` | Ask Dev device authorization codes | Ask Dev device flow service | Ask Dev device authorization completion | Random device and user codes; content_type=application/json; grant_type=authorization_code; grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code | Device authorization store | Short lived and single use. | live |
| `acr_web_assertion` | Web workload assertion for Ask Dev, and its approver reference on a device or consent approval | Web server with its own Ed25519 key | Ask Dev assertion verifier; for the approver reference, the Ask Dev pair check and the auth service policy decision point (from Ask Dev only) | Ed25519 compact JWT; dedicated_header=X-ACR-Web-Assertion; dedicated_header=X-ACR-Approver-Reference | Private key file at web; public JWKS at Ask Dev; public key metadata in the workload registry | At most 30 seconds; single-use token id; rotate by key id with overlap. The approver reference: at most 30 seconds plus 5 seconds of clock skew, never longer than its assertion. | live |
| `acr_workload_identity_exchange` | Ask Dev federated workload exchange | Kubernetes issues the subject; Ask Dev issues the resulting client credential | Ask Dev workload exchange | Projected ServiceAccount JWT exchanged for an fcacr_ credential; content_type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded | Result in the Ask Dev credential store with workload provenance | Re-exchange before the resulting credential expires. | live |
| `auth_js_browser_session` | Browser session wrapper | Web Auth.js | Web server routes and components | Encrypted JWT cookie | Browser cookie; wraps backend tokens | Backend access token refresh starts within 5 minutes of expiry. | live |
| `effective_principal_envelope` | Former go-api to query-api principal envelope | Former edge envelope issuer | None; query-api endpoint profiles refuse it | EdDSA compact JWT with schema version; authorization_scheme=Bearer; jwt_header_alg=EdDSA; jwt_header_typ=jwt | Stateless token; former verification JWKS file | Retired; former lifetime is 60 seconds; no active request path uses it. | retired |
| `email_verification_token` | Legacy signed email verification link | go-api registration and resend routes | go-api verification route; auth-service uses link_credential | HMAC-signed token id | Digest in public.email_verification_tokens | 24 hours; reissue replaces earlier tokens for that user. | retired |
| `external_push_ingest_token` | Organization-scoped External Push credential | Administrative ingest-token routes | External Push ingest routes | Opaque secret; credential_prefix=fcpush_; authorization_scheme=Bearer | Digest in public.external_ingest_tokens | Expiry and revocation on the credential row; replace through administration. | live |
| `github_app_installation_token` | Outbound GitHub App installation access | Backend signs the App JWT; GitHub issues the installation token | GitHub API | RS256 App JWT exchanged for an installation token | App private key in configured credential storage | App JWT is minted per exchange with a 10-minute maximum lifetime; installation token is short lived. | live |
| `github_webhook_signature` | GitHub delivery signature | GitHub with the configured shared secret | GitHub webhook handler | HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body; signature_header=X-Hub-Signature-256 | GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET in runtime secret configuration | Rotate at GitHub and update the configured secret. | live |
| `gitlab_webhook_signature` | GitLab delivery token | GitLab with the configured shared secret | No current route accepts it; the GitLab intake route is removed | Shared-secret header value; dedicated_header=X-Gitlab-Token | GITLAB_WEBHOOK_TOKEN in runtime secret configuration | Retired: go-api reads no GitLab webhook secret. | retired |
| `impersonation_session` | Effective-user context with a real actor | Administrative impersonation and auth-service delegated-session routes | Routes that check live impersonation or delegated-session state | Session id and actor identity; no standalone secret | public.impersonation_sessions and auth.sessions | Short lived; delegated sessions have no refresh credential; end or expiry removes authority. | live |
| `infrastructure_deployment_credentials` | Database, orchestration and TLS identities | Database, cluster or certificate administrator | Corresponding infrastructure service | Connection credentials, ServiceAccount tokens or certificates | Deployment secret manager or mounted secret files | Infrastructure-specific rotation; no single application expiry rule. | live |
| `internal_svc_acr_token` | Stored compatibility service credential for Ask Dev | Service-credential operator command | No current route accepts it | Opaque secret; credential_prefix=svc_acr_; authorization_scheme=Bearer | SHA-256 digest in public.internal_service_credentials | Operator rotation with optional overlap; stored rows can be revoked. | retired |
| `internal_svc_authsess_token` | Stored compatibility session-issuer credential | Service-credential operator command | No current route accepts it | Opaque secret; credential_prefix=svc_authsess_; authorization_scheme=Bearer | SHA-256 digest in public.internal_service_credentials | Operator rotation with optional overlap; use workload identity for session issuance. | retired |
| `internal_svc_worker_token` | Stored compatibility worker-operator credential | No current issuer; creation is disabled | No current route accepts it | Opaque secret; credential_prefix=svc_worker_; authorization_scheme=Bearer | SHA-256 digest in public.internal_service_credentials | Creation and rotation are disabled; existing rows can be listed and revoked. | retired |
| `jira_webhook_signature` | Jira delivery signature | Jira with the configured shared secret | No current route accepts it; the Jira intake route is removed | HMAC-SHA256; optional sha256= prefix; signature_header=X-Hub-Signature | JIRA_WEBHOOK_SECRET in runtime secret configuration | Retired: go-api reads no Jira webhook secret. | retired |
| `kubernetes_sa_token_exchange` | Kubernetes workload-exchange subject | Kubernetes API server | auth-service exchange through Kubernetes TokenReview | Bound projected ServiceAccount JWT for dev-health-workload-exchange; content_type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded; subject_token_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt | Projected file; auth-service does not store the subject token | Kubelet rotates it before expiry; exchange output cannot outlive it. | live |
| `license_key` | Signed platform license | License vendor | License and feature-entitlement validation | Ed25519-signed JSON payload and signature | Configured license string; LICENSE_PUBLIC_KEY for verification | Replace at deployment; payload expiry and grace-period checks apply. | live |
| `link_credential` | Auth-service verification or password-reset link | auth-service local sign-in and recovery flows | auth-service verification and reset routes, bound to purpose | Opaque base64url value from 32 random bytes | SHA-256 digest in auth.link_credentials | 24 hours for verification; 1 hour for reset; single use; reset is bound to the issuing token version. | live |
| `llm_api_keys` | Outbound model-provider API credentials | Configured model provider | Corresponding model-provider API | Provider-specific API key | Per-provider runtime environment or organization credential configuration | Rotate at the provider and update the configured key. | live |
| `oauth_authorization_code` | Ask Dev authorization-server code | auth-service consent approval | No token redemption route yet | Opaque secret; credential_prefix=fcoac_ | SHA-256 code_hash in auth.oauth_authorization_requests | 60 seconds; single use by contract. | live |
| `oauth_consent_csrf_token` | Consent request anti-CSRF value | auth-service consent description route | Consent approve and deny routes for the bound web session | Opaque secret; credential_prefix=fcocs_ | SHA-256 csrf_hash in auth.oauth_authorization_requests | One value per authorization request; never reissued; request expiry applies. | live |
| `ops_access_token_hs256` | Former symmetric user access token | Former authentication API; no current issuer | None; every endpoint profile refuses it | HS256 JWT; authorization_scheme=Bearer; jwt_header_alg=HS256 | Stateless token; former user-state checks | Retired; do not provision its signing secret. | retired |
| `ops_refresh_token` | Legacy signed refresh token | Former authentication flow; no current Go issuer | None; no endpoint-profile row accepts it. go-api forwards refresh and sign-out to auth-service, which accepts refresh_credential | HS256 JWT; body_field=refresh_token (jwt) | SHA-256 digest in public.refresh_tokens | Retired; a JWT-shaped refresh token is refused at refresh and revokes nothing at sign-out. | retired |
| `org_context_header` | Organization context, not an authentication credential | Requesting client or web proxy | Organization-scoped routes after authentication and membership checks | Organization UUID in a header; dedicated_header=X-Org-Id | Request only; membership is database state | Per request; confers no authority by itself. | live |
| `org_invite_token` | Organization invitation link | go-api invitation route or auth-service invitation store | Invitation acceptance routes in go-api and auth-service | 32 hex characters, dot, 64 hex characters | SHA-256 digest in public.org_invites or auth.invites | Reissue through the invitation flow; acceptance checks expiry and revocation. | live |
| `pagerduty_oauth_credential` | Outbound PagerDuty OAuth credential pair | PagerDuty OAuth service | PagerDuty API; worker credential hydration reads the stored pair | OAuth access and refresh tokens | Encrypted ciphertext in public.provider_oauth_credentials | Refresh before expiry under a credential lock. | live |
| `pagerduty_webhook_signature` | PagerDuty delivery signature | PagerDuty webhook subscription | PagerDuty webhook handler for the addressed binding | HMAC-SHA256; up to eight v1= signature candidates; signature_header=X-PagerDuty-Signature | Encrypted signing secret in public.pagerduty_webhook_bindings | Replace the binding secret and the subscription secret together. | live |
| `password_reset_token` | Legacy signed password-reset link | go-api password-recovery route | go-api password-reset route; auth-service uses link_credential | HMAC-signed token id | Digest in public.password_reset_tokens | 1 hour; reissue replaces earlier tokens for that user. | retired |
| `refresh_credential` | Auth-service refresh credential | auth-service session store | auth-service refresh and sign-out routes | Opaque dhr1_ prefix and 32 random bytes; body_field=refresh_credential (prefix:dhr1_); body_field=refresh_token (opaque:dhr1_) | SHA-256 digest in auth.refresh_credentials | 7-day rolling lifetime; single use; 30-second grace; reuse revokes the family. | live |
| `service_account_key` | Organization service-account exchange key | auth-service service-account key routes | auth-service token exchange when service-account exchange is enabled | Opaque secret; credential_prefix=fcsak_ | SHA-256 digest in auth.credential_registry; value returned once | Rotation overlap from 0 to 24 hours; one current key plus one overlapping key. | live |
| `service_account_token` | Organization service-account identity token | auth-service token exchange when enabled | No public resource route accepts this bearer yet; the exchange verifies its own issued token | EdDSA compact JWS; authorization_scheme=Bearer; jwt_header_alg=EdDSA; jwt_header_typ=sa+jwt | Stateless token; account and originating key are checked live | At most 300 seconds; cannot outlive its originating key. | live |
| `social_oauth_exchange` | Social sign-in provider token | Google, GitHub or GitLab | Social sign-in exchange | Provider OAuth access token | Transient callback data; not persisted by the backend | One sign-in exchange; provider controls expiry. | live |
| `sso_oidc_exchange` | Enterprise federated sign-in code | Organization OIDC identity provider | Configured OIDC sign-in callback | OIDC authorization code | Encrypted provider configuration in public.sso_providers | Single exchange; identity provider controls code expiry. | live |
| `sso_saml_exchange` | Enterprise federated sign-in assertion | Organization SAML identity provider | Configured SAML sign-in callback | Base64-encoded SAML XML | Provider configuration and encrypted secrets in public.sso_providers | Identity provider controls assertion expiry; replay checks apply; rotate its certificate through configuration. | live |
| `stripe_webhook_signature` | Stripe delivery signature | Stripe | Stripe webhook handler | Provider signature over the request body; signature_header=stripe-signature | STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET in runtime secret configuration | Rotate at Stripe and update the configured secret. | live |
| `user_access_token` | User identity and session token | auth-service | go-api and query-api for dev-health-api; auth-service session routes for auth-service | EdDSA compact JWS; authorization_scheme=Bearer; jwt_header_alg=EdDSA; jwt_header_typ=at+jwt | Stateless token; auth.sessions and user state are checked live | Reissued on refresh; 5 to 60 minutes, default 60 minutes. | live |
| `workload_bootstrap_credential` | Non-federated workload-exchange subject | auth-migrate workload bootstrap command | auth-service token exchange when bootstrap is enabled | Opaque secret; credential_prefix=fcwlb_; content_type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded; subject_token_type=urn:dev-health:params:oauth:token-type:workload-bootstrap | Value written once to a mode-0600 file; SHA-256 digest in auth.credential_registry | Rotation overlap from 0 to 1 hour; output token cannot outlive the credential. | live |
| `workload_token` | Service workload identity | auth-service token exchange | Audience-bound internal routes and authorization decision routes | EdDSA compact JWS; authorization_scheme=Bearer; jwt_header_alg=EdDSA; jwt_header_typ=workload+jwt | Stateless token; workload registry holds identity and allowed actions | Re-exchange before expiry; at most 300 seconds, bounded by the subject credential. | live |
